verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a document-processing platform. The only relevant evidence is a single pricing-page line listing "BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments", which implies customer-cloud deployment, likely an enterprise option. There is no documentation of how the core product is deployed or operated self-hosted. Missing for 10: deployment documentation or installation guide, clarity on which components run in the customer's environment versus Extend-hosted (hybrid), availability outside enterprise plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install.
